text:
leila_infra: Heads-up — scheduling a dry warmup burn for eu-north1 next Tue 03:00 UTC. Scope: autoscaler calibration, GPU pool warm-cache behavior, and egress path saturation checks. Need 2 oncall volunteers and a cost estimate.

tj: +1 for 03:00 UTC. I can take first 90m. What load profile are we running?

leila_infra: Plan is staged: 0->30m ramp to 50% of target qps, 30->90m hold at 100% plateau, 90->120m ramp down. Workload = chatty generation (avg 220 tokens, 1.2s server-side per token). Using dedicated pool eu-north1-ded.

alex_m: For loadgen we should use the new tools/loadgen binary (it streams prompt prefixes to hit KV caching). Command:
```
./tools/loadgen --region eu-north1 --pool eu-north1-ded-1 --profile chatty --vus 250 --duration 120m 
```
Make sure to flip --kv-cache=true to exercise prefix cache.

sarah_ops: I'll run the infra dashboards + tracing. Can you add a few model-fallback scenarios? We want to validate graceful degradation when a GPU node drops.

leila_infra: good call. We'll configure routing policy: primary -> rtx-a100-32, fallback -> rtx-a100-16 (quantized). Will intentionally drain one host at 45m to observe fallback.

ben_cost: Quick cost back-of-envelope: if we run 250 VUs sustaining ~10k RPS for 1.5h and average throughput consumes 20 GPU-hours, estimate ~20 GPU-hours -> at list ~$20/GPU-hr = $400, plus network egress ~ $60. Add buffer -> budget ~ $600 for the run. If we scale higher expect linear increase.

marta_sec: Reminder: update KMS policy to include temporary keys for test logging export. Also ensure no PII in prompts.

leila_infra: Noted, will scrub eval prompts. Instrumentation checklist:
- enable token-level tracing (rtoken=on)
- per-GPU util (prometheus node exporter)
- autoscaler events (controller logs)
- network egress monitor (vpc flow logs)
- model-fallback traces

alex_m: Autoscaler tuning suggestion based on past runs: target 75% GPU util to avoid queuing, scale_step = 2 nodes, scale_cooldown = 180s, min_replicas = 2, max_replicas = 40. Also set continuous_batch_max_tokens to 4096 for this profile.

leila_infra: We'll test three autoscaler configs across three canaries:
- canary A: conservative (util target 60%, scale_step 1)
- canary B: nominal (util target 75%, step 2)
- canary C: aggressive (util target 85%, step 4, aggressive cooldown)
We route 20% traffic to A, 60% to B, 20% to C.

tj: How do we split traffic? Traffic-split via runtime-routing flag?

alex_m: Use routing policy config in the console: route-weights on route id. CLI snippet:
```
redwood route update --route chat-gen --weights A=0.2,B=0.6,C=0.2 --region eu-north1
```
Also set probe endpoints so canaries have health checks.

sarah_ops: I'll watch for cold-start p99 spikes and queue depth. If p99 > 2.5s for >3min, we abort.

leila_infra: Network constraints: eu-north1 has egress throttles to our S3 mirror at peak; we should warm the object cache before peak. Pre-warm step: small curl-based priming for model shards and tokenizer assets.

alex_m: Pre-warm script:
```
for shard in shard-{1..24}; do curl -sS http://artifacts-eu-north1/$shard > /dev/null & done
```
Run 30m before load.

ben_cost: Note on reserved capacity: if we go over reserved baseline during soak, Dedicated billing still applies. Recommend spinning up ephemeral burst pool in same region to keep cost predictable.

marta_sec: Also confirm logging retention doesn't leak test payloads into long-term S3 buckets. Use short retention for test-run logs.

leila_infra: Handoff plan:
- 02:30 UTC: pre-warm assets and run smoke (alex_m)
- 02:50 UTC: start loadgen in dry-run mode (tj)
- 03:00 UTC: full warmup burn kicks off (tj + sarah_ops)
- 04:30 UTC: deliberate drain of host eu-north1-node-07 to trigger fallback (leila_infra)
- 05:00 UTC: cool-down and post-run metrics snapshot (all)

tj: I'll create a limited-duration pager schedule and add the oncall alias. Also posting run summary in #incidents if anything slips.

alex_m: Quick checkpoints to collect:
- avg GPU utilization per model type
- p50/p95/p99 latency streams by route
- autoscaler decision logs (scale up/down times + reasons)
- queue depth histogram
- KV cache hit ratio per prefix
- egress bandwidth and packet drops

sarah_ops: If we see headroom wasted (util < 55%) on B, increase target to 80% and re-run short test. If p99 climbs > threshold, revert.

leila_infra: Security signoff from Marta?

marta_sec: Signed. Just ensure the test keys are destroyed after 24h and that log scrubbing job ran. I'll join the first 30m.

deploy-bot: warmup-burn job scheduled by leila_infra for 2025-06-17T03:00:00Z (id: wb-20250617-eun1). Reminder: check quota before starting.

leila_infra: Thanks all. Putting final checklist here — will update if anything changes. :rocket:
